verdict.rationale: Steel documents first-party integrations that run OpenAI's vision-based Computer Use loop on a Steel browser session, alongside Claude and Gemini Computer Use integrations. It also exposes screenshot APIs, so developers can use screenshot-driven computer-use agents alongside the CDP/DOM path. missing for 10: detail on how computer-use actions handle canvases or UIs the DOM path can't reach, depth beyond one-line integration descriptions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
